defs.def: （用于否定句和疑问句，谈论尚未发生但可能发生的事）

ex.s: Similarly, the corporate world has certainly known its fair share of disruption, yet it is only in the last couple of decades that the “Disruptor” has become a recognisable figure in the way we talk about big business.
ex.t: 同样，企业界确实经历了相当多的颠覆，但直到最近几十年，“颠覆者”才成为我们谈论大企业时一个可识别的角色。

ex.s: Yet while an Innovator creates something new, the Disruptor is defined as much by what they destroy as by what they create.
ex.t: 然而，创新者创造新事物，而颠覆者的定义，既在于他们创造了什么，也在于他们摧毁了什么。

ex.s: If we’re too impetuous, we can end up tearing out things we don’t yet realise we rely upon.
ex.t: 如果我们太鲁莽，最终可能会拆除那些我们尚未意识到自己正依赖着的东西。

ex.s: At 15, I excelled academically yet felt overshadowed and unnoticed.
ex.t: 15岁时，我学业优异却感到被忽视、不被注意。

ex.s: Serving hard-to-find Thai dishes in an elegant atmosphere, the restaurant is true to Thai cuisine’s roots, yet still manages to add a special twist.
ex.t: 餐厅在优雅的氛围中供应难觅的泰式菜肴，既忠于泰菜的本源，又巧妙增添了特别的变化。

ex.s: Such wrinkles will no doubt be ironed out, yet they also point to a fundamental problem.
ex.t: 这些瑕疵无疑会被消除，但它们也指向一个根本问题。

ex.s: Trembling, they were yet laughing and hugging each other.
ex.t: 他们颤抖着，却笑着互相拥抱。

ex.s: narrow down to what has not yet been covered in online tests
ex.t: 缩小到在线测试中尚未涵盖的内容

ex.s: Such methods seem obvious, yet so often we just don’t think.
ex.t: 这些方法看起来显而易见，但我们往往就是想不到。

ex.s: Yet properly understood, the age of electricity is merely the second stage in the age of steam, which began a century earlier.
ex.t: 然而正确理解的话，电力时代仅仅是蒸汽时代的第二阶段，蒸汽时代开始于一个世纪前。

ex.s: And yet messengers of the coming disturbance are likely to be ignored.
ex.t: 然而即将到来的动荡的信使很可能被忽视。

ex.s: Yet, the only one who cares about any mistake is the one who is speaking.
ex.t: 然而，唯一在意任何错误的，是那个正在说话的人。

ex.s: Yet the researchers suggest that single parents still may play a role in teaching the benefits of persistence, which is an avenue of future research.
ex.t: 然而，研究人员指出，单亲父母仍可能在教导坚持的好处方面发挥作用，这是未来研究的一个方向。

ex.s: Yet, I was determined to go ahead.
ex.t: 到了3英里处，我看到一个标志："加油，跑步者们！"

ex.s: It is the resources yet to be used
ex.t: 如果情节、人物或词汇用法让你困惑，你可能无法记住你读的内容。

ex.s: It was filled with surprises and amusements, all because of my mother---loving, sweet, yet absent-minded and forgetful.
ex.t: 生活中充满了惊喜和趣事，这一切都因为我的母亲——充满爱心、温柔甜蜜，却又心不在焉、健忘。

ex.s: Some argue that humans and machines can coexist as long as they work in teams—yet that is not possible unless machines share the goals of humans.
ex.t: 有人认为人类和机器可以共存，只要他们团队合作——但除非机器分享人类的目标，否则这是不可能的。

ex.s: Yet the exact opposite was true: the participants who made deliberate errors learned about twice as much as the people who simply copied out the correct definitions.
ex.t: 然而事实恰恰相反：那些故意犯错的参与者学到的东西大约是单纯抄写正确定义的人的两倍。

ex.s: We have not found life on any other planets yet.
ex.t: 我们尚未在任何其他行星上发现生命。

ex.s: Some families have yet to return, but many others have come back.
ex.t: 一些家庭尚未返回，但许多其他家庭已经回来了。

ex.s: Yet， now that I'm growing and the world I once knew as being so simple is becoming more complex， I find myself needing a way to escape． By opening a novel， I can leave behind my burdens and enter into a wonderful and mysterious world where I am now a new character． In these worlds I can become anyone． I don't have to write down what happened or what technique the author was using when he or she wrote this． I just read to relax．
ex.t: 然而，随着我渐渐长大，曾经以为如此简单的世界变得越来越复杂，我发现自己需要一种逃避的方式。打开一本小说，我就能抛开烦恼，进入一个奇妙而神秘的世界，在那里我成为一个新的角色。在这些世界里我可以成为任何人。我不必记下发生了什么，也不必分析作者写作时运用了什么技巧。我阅读只是为了放松。

defs.def: now; as soon as this 用于否定句
from now until the period of time mentioned has passed 从现在起直至某一时间；还

ex.s: Since it wasn't dark yet after the meal, I decided to walk home from the restaurant.
ex.t: 因为饭后天还没黑，我决定从餐厅走路回家。

ex.s: Yet, as I thought about Juan’s question, I was not sure how much more we could really rule out.
ex.t: 然而，当我想到胡安的问题时，我不确定我们还能真正排除多少。

ex.s: Yet as Martin has found in her work, gender is one of the fundamental ways people form connections with objects, particularly those designed with human characteristics.
ex.t: 然而，正如马丁在她的工作中发现的那样，性别是人们与物品建立联系的基本方式之一，尤其是那些被设计成具有人类特征的物品。

ex.s: The human brain has potential yet to be developed.
ex.t: 人类大脑有待开发的潜力。

ex.s: Every time I gave a self-introduction, I had to explain how to pronounce my name at least five times, yet they still could not say it the way I did.
ex.t: 每次我作自我介绍时，都不得不把我的名字怎么读解释至少五遍，可他们还是说不出我那种读法。

ex.s: Yet, when something new turns up, more often than not, we do not even know its name.
ex.t: 然而，当新事物出现时，我们往往甚至不知道它的名字。

ex.s: Now we have the most direct evidence yet that he is right.
ex.t: 现在我们有了最直接的证据证明他是对的。

defs.def: （表示将来可能发生，尽管现在似乎没有可能）早晚，总有一天

ex.s: I had traveled that way before, yet I had never noticed that old little shop.
ex.t: 我以前曾经这样旅行过，但我从来没有注意到那个古老的小商店。

ex.s: Unfortunately, that plan seems unlikely to work: we have yet to invent a firewall that is secure against ordinary humans, let alone super intelligent machines.
ex.t: 可惜，那个计划似乎不太可能奏效：我们至今还没发明出一种能挡住普通人的防火墙，更别说超级智能机器了。

ex.s: But the war was not over yet.
ex.t: 但战争还没有结束。

ex.s: Nothing like this has been invented yet and I’d say we’re a long way from an invention like that at the moment!
ex.t: 目前还没有类似的东西被发明出来，我想我们离那样的发明还有很长的路要走！

ex.s: Who knows, perhaps some of the more forward-looking   65   (one) may yet come out with a whole range of “just for you” pack sizes with special offers as well.
ex.t: 他们弄清楚自己擅长什么。___36___刺猬理念对公司来说完全适用。

ex.s: Yet none of the existing models includes such processes.
ex.t: 然而，现有的模型中没有一个包含这样的过程。

ex.s: Yet as the months of reducing waste continued, I did what I could that was within my own reach.
ex.t: 然而随着减少浪费的日子一天天过去，我在力所能及的范围内尽我所能。

ex.s: Yet instead of being discouraged by my   54   progress, I was excited.
ex.t: 然而，我没有因为进展____而气馁，反而很兴奋。

ex.s: Yet, despite all this, by the end of the trip many were already planning to return.
ex.t: 然而，尽管如此，到旅行结束时，许多人已经计划返回。

ex.s: Yet the problem, by just about any measure, appears to be getting worse.
ex.t: 然而，无论从哪个标准看，这个问题似乎都在变得更糟。

defs.def: the best, longest, etc. thing of its kind made, produced, written, etc. until now/then 迄今为止，到当时为止（最好或最长等的）

ex.s: Weighing in at more than 800, 000 pounds, the Boise sequoia is its largest undertaking yet.
ex.t: 这棵博伊西红杉重达80多万磅，是迄今为止规模最大的搬运工程。

ex.s: Yet what began as a recipe book became a kind of memoir.
ex.t: 然而，最初作为食谱书的东西变成了一本回忆录。

ex.s: We don't know yet if it's bad thing.
ex.t: 我们还不知道这是不是一件坏事。

ex.s: Yet "Apes" is more exception than the rule.
ex.t: 然而，《猿》电影更多是例外而非规则。

ex.s: Far from charging consumers high prices, many of these services are free (users pay, in effect, by handing over yet more data).
ex.t: 远非向消费者收取高价，许多这类服务都是免费的（用户实际上是通过交出更多数据来付费的）。

ex.s: Indeed, the researchers found that face-to-face interactions and conversations affect the creative process, and yet a coworking space or a coffee shop provides a certain level of noise while also providing freedom from interruptions.
ex.t: 的确，研究人员发现面对面互动和对话会影响创造过程，而联合办公空间或咖啡店提供一定程度的噪音，同时也提供不受打扰的自由。

chunks.en: yet as / new / say / come / point / covered / manages / realise / laughing
chunks.cn: 然而 / 仍是新的 / 然而说 / 即将到来 / 然而指出 / 尚未覆盖 / 然而设法 / 然而意识到 / 然而笑着
